Armen Leonovich Takhtajan or Takhtajian [ a ] ( Armenian : Արմեն Լևոնի Թախտաջյան ; Russian : Армен Леонович Тахтаджян ; pronounced takh-tuh-JAHN [ needs  IPA ] ; 10 June 1910 – 13 November 2009), was a Soviet - Armenian botanist , one of the most important figures in 20th century plant evolution and systematics and biogeography . His other interests included morphology of flowering plants , paleobotany , and the flora of the Caucasus . He was one of the most influential taxonomists of the latter twentieth century.
